recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Nomad/Samurai use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Nomad/Samurai card.

items.label: Source castle
items.description: Choose the Great Empire castle that supplies troops and tools for camp attacks.
items.recommendation: Use your usual event castle with enough troops and tools.

items.label: Nomad attack preset
items.description: Select a saved Attack Preset with the troops, tools and formation for Nomad camps.
items.recommendation: Create and select your regular Nomad preset.

items.label: Samurai attack preset
items.description: Select a saved Attack Preset with the troops, tools and formation for Samurai camps.
items.recommendation: Create and select your regular Samurai preset.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose the feather, coin or ruby travel option for camp attacks.
items.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Nomad/Samurai source, presets and travel settings
image.caption: Create both event presets before selecting their source castle and travel option.

items.label: Nomad difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Nomad difficulty for event start.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Samurai difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Samurai difficulty for event start.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Already active event
items.description: For an active event, match its current difficulty because a different saved choice makes this automation wait rather than change it.

image.alt: Illustrative Nomad and Samurai difficulty choices
image.caption: Select a separate unlocked difficulty for each event and match the active one.

items.label: Stop at event score
items.description: Stop starting new attacks when the reported event score reaches or exceeds this target.
items.recommendation: Use your usual final personal-reward milestone above 0.

items.label: Stop before event ends
items.description: Stop starting new attacks this many minutes before the event ends.
items.recommendation: 30 minutes.

items.label: Daily normal-attack limit
items.description: Stop this automation at the account-wide daily normal-attack count until the game resets it; 0 adds no limit.
items.recommendation: 0 so the event score target controls the run.

items.label: Travelling attacks
items.description: Attacks already travelling may finish after a stop condition and push the final score above the target.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Nomad/Samurai score and stopping limits
image.caption: The score target stops new launches while already travelling attacks may finish.

items.label: Clear each landed hit cooldown
items.description: After a confirmed camp victory, use an available time skip to clear that target cooldown.
items.recommendation: On for regular repeated camp attacks; leave off to wait for natural cooldowns.

items.label: Keep 1m
items.description: Keep this many 1m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular camp runs.

items.label: Keep 5m
items.description: Keep this many 5m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular camp runs.

items.label: Keep 10m
items.description: Keep this many 10m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular camp runs.

items.label: Keep 30m
items.description: Keep this many 30m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular camp runs.

items.label: Keep 60m
items.description: Keep this many 60m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular camp runs.

items.label: Keep 5h
items.description: Keep this many 5h time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

items.label: Keep 24h
items.description: Keep this many 24h time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

image.alt: Illustrative camp cooldown and time-skip reserve settings
image.caption: Each keep value counts time-skip items, not minutes of cooldown.

steps.title: Leave the temporary trial off for routine runs

items.label: Temporary RBC end-to-end trial
items.description: Replace normal event operation with a real attack trial on one Robber Baron Castle using the Nomad preset and cooldown skips.
items.recommendation: Off for regular Nomad or Samurai runs.

items.label: Target X
items.description: Enter the Robber Baron Castle horizontal coordinate only for the temporary trial.
items.recommendation: Leave unused while the trial is off.

items.label: Target Y
items.description: Enter the Robber Baron Castle vertical coordinate only for the temporary trial.
items.recommendation: Leave unused while the trial is off.

items.label: Trial cooldown skips
items.description: Enabling the trial also turns on cooldown skips for that trial.

image.alt: Illustrative temporary Robber Baron Castle trial controls
image.caption: The trial makes a real attack and replaces normal event operation while enabled.

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save the source, presets, difficulties, stopping limits, skip choices and trial state before closing this dialog.

items.label: Auto Nomad/Samurai switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Nomad/Samurai on the Automation card after saving to run when an event and eligible resources are available.
items.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.

items.label: Camp readiness
items.description: The automation levels event camps and waits for eligible commanders, troops, tools and usable skips when skips are enabled.
